_doc: Research & Standards — national labs and research consortia. Keyed by cleaned-name token; see ENRICHMENT_PROMPT.md.

argonne national laboratory.one_liner: US DOE lab; CAMP cell-fab facility and Battery500/ReCell hubs.

national renewable energy laboratory.one_liner: US DOE renewable-energy lab; battery testing & analysis.

the faraday institution.one_liner: UK's flagship battery research programme & talent pipeline.

lawrence berkeley.one_liner: US DOE national laboratory; part of the Battery500 consortium researching next-gen Li-metal cells.

oak ridge.one_liner: US DOE national laboratory researching battery materials and manufacturing.

fraunhofer.one_liner: German applied-research organization; battery-relevant institutes include ISI (innovation research) and IKTS (ceramics/materials).

karlsruhe institute.one_liner: German university and research institute; affiliated with the Helmholtz Institute Ulm for battery research.

university of warwick.one_liner: UK university; WMG (Warwick Manufacturing Group) is a major battery and automotive research center.

tsinghua university.one_liner: Leading Chinese university with battery-materials research programs.
